author: reek
body: Length of a single segment. For axis-aligned segments this is the absolute difference along the active axis. For diagonal segments we approximate with Manhattan distance.

author: reek
body: Generate an L-shaped route between two points: a horizontal segment followed by a vertical segment. If the two points share an axis, only one segment is produced. A junction is placed at the bend point.

author: reek
body: Route a wire between two points using the selected mode. Manual mode falls back to orthogonal routing.

author: reek
body: Two adjacent segments are collinear if they share an axis and one segment's endpoint equals the next segment's start point on that axis. Merge them into a single segment spanning the full range.
